MAX_LOCK_DURATION().details: For more information on the token locking pre-migration see IBurnableTokenActions.

returns._0: The maximum locking duration in seconds for the bought tokens.

MIN_LOCK_DURATION().details: For more information on the token locking pre-migration see IBurnableTokenActions.

returns._0: The minimum locking duration in seconds for the bought tokens.

buyToken(uint256,string).details: It calculates the amount of tokens to be bought based on the bonding curve's buy logic and ensures that the minimum amount of tokens to be received is met. It also checks that the bonding curve is not locked (until the token migrates). Emits a Buy event upon successful completion.

params.id: A unique identifier for the creator of the bonding curve. This is used in the frontend (emitted in an event) to distinguish between different accounts with the same wallet address. The id is either the FID (Farcaster ID) or the DID (Privy's Decentralized Identifier). If you want to skip this, you can pass an empty string or '0'.
params.minAmount: The minimum amount of tokens to receive in return for the ETH sent.

buyTokenForDev(address,uint256,string).details: This function is intended to be called only by the bonding curve factory during the creation of the bonding curve. It calculates the amount of tokens to be bought based on the bonding curve's buy logic and ensures that the minimum amount of tokens to be received is met. Emits a Buy event upon successful completion.

params.dev: The address of the developer for whom the tokens are being bought.
params.id: A unique identifier for the creator of the bonding curve. This is used in the frontend (emitted in an event) to distinguish between different accounts with the same wallet address. The id is either the FID (Farcaster ID) or the DID (Privy's Decentralized Identifier). If you want to skip this, you can pass an empty string or '0'.
params.minAmount: The minimum amount of tokens to receive in return for the ETH sent.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to buy.

returns._0: The amount of ETH to be sent in order to buy the specified amount of tokens.

params._amount: The amount of tokens to sell.

returns._0: The amount of ETH to be received in return for the specified amount of tokens.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to buy or sell.

returns._0: The fee amount to be charged by the protocol.

factory().details: The bonding curve factories can change. Use IFactoryManager to get the current active factory and for centralized creation of bonding curves.

returns._0: The address of the bonding curve factory that created this bonding curve.
The address of the FeeAccount contract.
The raised amount of ETH in the bonding curve.

initialize(string,string,bytes,uint16,ad.details: Initializes the bonding curve contract with the necessary parameters.This contract is intended to be created by a bonding curve factory, or by the factory manager (see IBondingCurveFactory and IFactoryManager).

params._feeAccount: The address that will receive fees.
params._isDevLocked: Whether the developer's tokens are locked.
params._metadata: The metadata of the token, which can include additional information such as description, image URL, etc.
params.liquidityMigrator: The address of the liquidity migrator contract.
params.name: The name of the token.

isOnCurve().details: Once the bonding curve is created, it is operational and once the token migrates it is deactivated. Buy and sell operations will revert if the bonding curve is not operational. It cannot be reactivated.

returns._0: Whether the bonding curve is currently active and operational.
The address of the ILiquidityMigrator contract.

sellToken(uint256,uint256,string).details: It transfers the specified amount of tokens from the caller to the contract and then calculates the reimbursement amount based on the bonding curve's sell logic. It ensures that the amount to be sold is positive and that the minimum amount to be received is met. It also checks that the caller has enough tokens to sell and that the bonding curve is not locked (until the token migrates). Emits a Sell event upon successful completion.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to sell.
params.id: A unique identifier for the creator of the bonding curve. This is used in the frontend (emitted in an event) to distinguish between different accounts with the same wallet address. The id is either the FID (Farcaster ID) or the DID (Privy's Decentralized Identifier). If you want to skip this, you can pass an empty string or '0'.
params.minAmount: The minimum amount of tokens to receive in return.

returns._0: The instance of the BurnableToken contract.

buyToken(uint256,string).notice: This function allows users to buy tokens from the bonding curve using ETH.The function uses msg.sender as a sender and reciever.The function is NOT blocked from being called if the msg.sender is locked from transfering (see extendLockDuration(address,uint256) in IBurnableTokenActions).

buyTokenForDev(address,uint256,string).notice: This function allows the developer to be the first to buy tokens from the bonding curve using ETH.

calculateContinuousBuyReturn(uint256).notice: This function calculates how much tokens can be bought for a specified amount of ETH on the bonding curve. This does not include the fee.

calculateContinuousSellReturn(uint256).notice: This function calculates how much ETH can be received for a specified amount of tokens on the bonding curve. This does not include the fee.

calculateFee(uint256).notice: This function calculates the fee amount to be charged by the protocol for a given amount of tokens being bought or sold.

feeAccount().notice: The FeeAccount contract manages the collected fees.

migrator().notice: The ILiquidityMigrator contract manages the migration of tokens and creaing liquidity pools.

sellToken(uint256,uint256,string).notice: This function allows users to sell tokens they hold on the bonding curve for ETH.The function uses msg.sender as a sender and reciever.The function is blocked from being called if the msg.sender is locked from transfering (see extendLockDuration(address,uint256) in IBurnableTokenActions).

token().notice: This function returns the instance of the BurnableToken associated with this bonding curve.
